title: Developing a Multilingual Annotated Corpus of Misogyny and Aggression
benchmark_measurement: Detection of misogyny and aggression, including cases where gender bias is mixed with or framed in terms of religious bias.
findings: The study found that misogynistic and aggressive language sometimes involves mixed biases, where gender bias is combined with religious bias. Religion can be used as a 'smokescreen' to propagate gender bias, or gender issues can be presented as religious issues, complicating the annotation and detection process.
